regions.region: page 19 upper-left continuation of Scheme 3 equation 5
regions.finding: The existing 3aa/Z-4aa/E-4aa control was enriched with the exact mixture charge and ratio, DMAc volume, vial/100 °C/8.5 h operation, TLC endpoint, aqueous extraction/drying sequence, mesitylene amount, and 74% crude 1H NMR yield. No atmosphere is stated.

The second uncatalyzed control was enriched independently with its own mixture charge and ratio, solvent volume, identical timed heating/workup sequence, mesitylene amount, and 80% crude 1H NMR yield. It was not merged with the different-mixture equation-5 run.

The palladium-assisted control was enriched with exact catalyst, ligand, allylic-azide-mixture and DMAc charges, sequential N2 charging, 100 °C/3 h hold, TLC endpoint, workup, mesitylene amount, and 72% crude 1H NMR yield.

regions.region: page 19 upper-right one-pot preparation and structure of 5na
regions.finding: The existing 1n/2a/NaN3 record was enriched with all exact charges, split DMAc carrier volumes, ordered N2 charging, the 25 °C/23 h stage, an explicitly untimed transition to 130 °C, the 130 °C/21 h stage, workup, 800 mL chromatography eluent, and 5na 0.1022 g/38%. The yield remains attached to the entire one-pot two-stage sequence.
